name: label-catalog-async
description: The label catalog is larger than the synchronous 500-object collection cap. The first fetch returns exactly 500 labels, which is indistinguishable from a truncated catalog, so the catalog is re-run as an asynchronous GET collection -- the same 202/Location/poll/datafile escape hatch the workload collection uses -- and the datafile is streamed. A workload carrying a bare href reference to a label that exists only in the asynchronous remainder (lb-0502) must import with that label resolved to its key:value tag rather than as an unresolved reference.

log_contains: the label catalog returned the 500 object collection cap; re-running it as an asynchronous GET collection
